## Open

<a id="Q-1"></a>
### Q-1 — Is a redraw a new sample, or the same one again?

- **Leaning:** a new sample on a new request — the failed request stays as it ended
- **Option:** a new sample on a new request — nothing changes in the model; the doctor asks again
- **Option:** the same sample again — a way back from Haemolysed to Drawn on the sample, and the route reopens
- **About:** [R16](patient.md#R16)
- **Asked:** session 1, 2026-03-02

## Answered

<a id="Q-2"></a>
### Q-2 — From when does a sample's stability count?

- **Leaning:** from when it is collected
- **Asked:** session 1, 2026-03-02
- **Answer:** from when its run is expected; on the analyser's queue it is kept cool and no longer ages
- **Recorded in:** [R10](analysis.md#R10)

<a id="Q-3"></a>
### Q-3 — What is a site, and can an analysis be planned at any of them?

- **Leaning:** a clinic or a lab; only a lab runs an analysis, and one planned elsewhere is flagged
- **Asked:** session 2, 2026-03-09
- **Answer:** agreed, with the leaning — the planner is told at once
- **Recorded in:** [R17](analysis.md#R17)
